title.zh: 界面焕新，与官网风格统一

description.en: The OpenAgents style is now the default, in the brand's deep blue with fewer lines. The previous look remains available as Classic in Settings → Appearance.
description.zh: 默认采用 OpenAgents 风格，主色改为品牌深蓝，线条更简洁。原外观保留为「经典」，可在「设置 → 外观」中切换。

title.zh: 智能体启动、停止响应更快

title.en: Agents already removed from their workspace can be deleted again
title.zh: 已移出工作区的智能体可以正常删除

title.en: DeepSeek Harness installs and runs again
title.zh: DeepSeek Harness 恢复正常安装与使用

title.en: OpenClaw migrates its data automatically after an upgrade
title.zh: OpenClaw 升级后自动迁移旧数据

title.en: Agents with their own API key no longer use another agent's endpoint or model
title.zh: 单独配置 API Key 的智能体不再沿用同类智能体的接口地址或模型
